purpose: Indicate a striking degree or a strong inferred reason.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
よほど / よっぽど + predicate
You keep rereading it; you must really like it.
Taking the train is much faster than walking.
Unless there is a very good reason, I will not change the plan.
formation: よほど / よっぽど + predicate
register: Neutral; よっぽど is casual
restrictions: Can intensify a comparison or infer a great degree from behavior.
mistake: The strength of the inference remains the speaker’s judgment.
